remarks: Bright and spacious first-floor apartment in 3 family home in a friendly neighborhood. Includes heat, hot water and trash removal. No pets and no smokers. located near schools, parks, tennis courts, and beach. Features a living room, dining room, eat-in kitchen with a sleek black quartz countertop. Includes 2 well-sized bedrooms with ample closet space, a home office/den, and a full bathroom with new vanity. Laundry in basement. Enjoy the outdoor deck and beautiful backyard. One assigned off-street parking space. Available 3/15/25 or sooner for 1 year or longer. Excellent credit, verified employment and background checks required.
